CustomField.description: Flow-mode only field (the screen component runs with isFlow=true inside a Screen Flow). When a non-blank value (currently 'Bypass') is set, the formTemplate LWC treats moving forward off this page as a Flow navigation event: instead of advancing the page internally it dispatches FlowNavigationNext/Finish so the surrounding Screen Flow regains control after this page. Evaluated in formTemplate.js next-page logic alongside Auto Save and the Save Progress signal (priorPage[Action__c] truthy check). Leave blank for self-contained templates that never hand control back to the Flow mid-form. Has no effect when the template renders standalone (isFlow false) or in Stages Mode.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank unless this Form Template runs inside a Screen Flow and you need that Flow to take over when the respondent moves forward from this page. Selecting a value makes the form fire a Flow Next/Finish navigation off this page so your surrounding Flow can run an action; it has no effect on standalone or Stages-mode templates.
CustomField.label: Flow Action
